descriptions.job-0nfh8ml:
BUILT DIFFERENT

We believe there's a better way to build. One that moves faster, thinks bigger, and gives people the ownership to challenge what's been done before. We're not here to follow the standard. We're here to set a new one. We don't believe the best work happens inside rigid boxes. People are given real ownership, real responsibility, and the space to operate beyond a title. Scope grows with impact and responsibility grows with trust. And the people who step up help shape what comes next. We're building an organization around ownership, where your influence is defined by what you take on. An internship at Hut 8 provides you with the opportunity to take on real work and drive real outcomes.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The infrastructure is ambitious. The people behind it should be too.

We’re looking for an Electrical Engineering intern who is curious, asks “why,” and wants to do real engineering work from day one. You’ll work side by side with our engineers on live data center projects, contribute to designs and studies that actually get built, and leave with work you can point to.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

+  Learn it: Get hands-on with the electrical systems behind a data center: utility interconnects, substations, switchgear, generators, UPS, and power distribution

+  Support it: Help our engineers build one-line diagrams and run short-circuit, arc-flash, and protection coordination studies, with guidance and review from licensed PEs

+  See it built: Join site visits, follow field issues from question to fix, and watch a design turn into construction, commissioning, and energization

+  Challenge it: Ask hard questions about cost, constructability, and redundancy. Fresh eyes are an asset here, and safety and reliability always come first

+  Own it: Take on a defined project of your own, from first question to final recommendation, and present it to the team at the end of your internship

WHAT YOU BRING

+  Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s program in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field, such as Power or Energy Systems, Electrical Engineering Technology, Architectural Engineering (electrical/MEP), or Computer, Mechatronics, or Nuclear Engineering with a power systems foundation

+  Graduating in December 2027 or June 2028 with an undergraduate or graduate degree

+  Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.3

+  Coursework in circuits, power systems, electromagnetics, or power electronics

+  Real interest in critical power and data center infrastructure

+  Comfort with AutoCAD, MATLAB, or Python, and the ability to pick up new engineering software quickly

+  Track record of personal accountability, integrity, and respect for others, the company, and oneself

+  Exceptional interpersonal skills to support team cohesion and successful project execution

+  Strong written and verbal communication skills for working with diverse groups and individuals

+  Comfortable working in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities and multiple deadlines, while contributing to inclusive and cooperative teams

+  Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

BUILT FOR THIS

If you are curious, hungry to learn, drawn to hard problems, willing to ask “why,” and ready to do real work from week one.

+   You’ve used SKM, ETAP, EasyPower, or similar power-system software in a class or lab

+   You’ve worked or interned in construction, utilities, or industrial settings, or built something hands-on

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role is in office at our corporate headquarters in the Brickell area of Miami, Florida. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

"People are our greatest differentiator: an environment where high performers thrive, where collaboration drives impact, and where careers are shaped by opportunity, not hierarchy."

Asher Genoot, Architect

Solutions Architect

Our Solutions Architecture team connects business priorities with practical technical solutions, helping customers understand how Chainalysis can support their most important objectives.

In this role, you will provide technical leadership throughout the customer journey. You will turn complex requirements into clear recommendations, help customers envision how our products fit into their operating environment, and guide them toward measurable business outcomes.

As a Solutions Architect, you'll develop a deep understanding of Chainalysis solutions and the problems our customers are trying to solve. You'll explain complex concepts in a clear, compelling way to technical practitioners, business leaders, and executive stakeholders. You'll also build practical, customer-specific solutions that support deployment, integration, adoption, and long-term value.

In this role, you'll:

  • Serve as a core member of the account team, partnering closely with Sales, Services, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering.

  • Take ownership of customer outcomes across the full lifecycle, from initial discovery and solution design through investigation support, compliance program delivery, deployment, enablement, adoption, and expansion.

  • Lead discovery conversations that uncover customer objectives, operational pain points, use cases, technical constraints, and success criteria.

  • Translate business and operational needs into clear technical requirements, solution designs, and implementation paths.

  • Articulate Chainalysis capabilities in a way that is relevant to each customer's compliance, risk, fraud, investigations, or security environment.

  • Create tailored demonstrations, proof-of-value experiences, and technical narratives that show how Chainalysis can address customer priorities.

  • Conduct blockchain investigations, deliver compliance and regulatory guidance, and build technical solutions such as notebooks, dashboards, automation workflows, data integrations, reference architectures, and agentic workflows.

  • Develop AI-assisted workflows that accelerate and automate investigations, analysis, and customer processes, adapted to each customer's operating model, data, controls, and risk framework.

  • Design automation that fits into existing compliance, risk, fraud, investigations, or security operations rather than requiring customers to redesign how they work.

  • Help customers access and operationalize Chainalysis data through APIs, integrations, and fit-for-purpose technical patterns.

  • Provide guidance on solution architecture, API implementation, workflow design, data movement, and integration considerations.

  • Drive platform adoption by connecting customer workflows to Chainalysis capabilities and identifying new use cases.

  • Identify creative, responsible approaches to difficult customer problems, while balancing speed, scalability, security, maintainability, and measurable impact.

  • Build trust through sound technical judgment, clear communication, reliable execution, and a strong understanding of the customer's business.

  • Assemble the technical evidence base, including outcome data, consumption metrics, adoption analysis, and expansion signals, that supports quarterly impact reporting and renewal conversations.

  • Build customer capability and self-sufficiency rather than creating ongoing dependence on the Solutions Architecture team.

  • Own the feedback loop between customers and Product/Engineering, translating field insights and feature requirements into product improvements and bringing those improvements back to customers.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to customers, meeting them at their current level of crypto-maturity and partnering with them to advance their understanding, processes, and outcomes.

  • Represent Chainalysis at customer meetings, industry events, and conferences.

  • Contribute to the wider Solutions Architecture team through reusable assets, knowledge sharing, internal initiatives, and better ways of working.

We're looking for candidates who have:

  • Several years of experience in one or more relevant areas, such as financial services, compliance, investigations, fraud, cybersecurity, digital assets, transaction monitoring, sales engineering, solutions architecture, or enterprise product management.

  • Experience making complex technical or operational concepts understandable to different audiences.

  • Strong storytelling, presentation, and written communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical teams and executive stakeholders.

  • A creative, structured, and investigative approach to solving challenging customer problems.

  • Comfort working with technical tools and learning new technologies quickly. Experience with Python or another programming language, SQL, data analysis, notebooks, workflow automation, APIs, integrations, or AI tools is valuable.

  • The curiosity and initiative to develop technical depth over time; you do not need to arrive with a complete technical stack, but you should enjoy investigating how things work and building the skills to solve new problems.

  • The ability to operate effectively when requirements are ambiguous, information is incomplete, or the best path forward has not yet been defined.

  • A collaborative, generous approach to working with others, including a willingness to share knowledge, seek input, and improve team practices.

  • A demonstrated focus on measurable customer outcomes, not simply technical activity or product usage.

  • An interest in blockchain and a desire to keep building your understanding of the technology, the market, and the customers we serve.

Total Compensation:
• Base Salary Range: $160,000-$185,000
• Offers Commission: 75/25 OTE
• Offers Equity

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code.   • Assist incident investigations by gathering information and performing on-site diagnostics.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe Press publishes ideas for progress in technology, science, and economics because we believe that for many of the most significant breakthroughs in each of these categories, the key ingredient is ideas. The Stripe Press team is effectively a startup within Stripe; we have an unusual amount of autonomy and the trust of Stripe’s leadership team. 

Our bar for publishing is high, and our list is small—by design. We’d rather publish fewer books than publish books we’re not passionate about and that we don’t think will challenge and galvanize our audience, which is global, fiercely curious, and shares our exacting standards.

What you’ll do

Stripe Press is seeking a Managing Editor to own the editorial development and execution of its publishing program. You will guide intellectually ambitious nonfiction from acquisition through final proofs and production-ready handoff, upholding Press’s standards for rigor, clarity, accuracy, and editorial distinction.

This role calls for exceptional editorial judgment and project management skills. You will work closely with Stripe Press’s editors, production manager, designers, authors, agents, and external specialists. You will also help build the systems and contributor network needed to support a growing list without compromising quality.

Responsibilities

  • Own the editorial path of every Stripe Press book from acquisition through final proofs and handoff to production.
  • Establish and manage editorial schedules spanning manuscript delivery, editorial review, revision, copyediting, fact-checking, permissions, indexing, proofreading, and final approval.
  • Evaluate manuscripts for structure, argument, clarity, pacing, voice, evidence, and accessibility, ensuring that complex ideas remain accurate and intellectually substantive.
  • Establish clear expectations with authors and provide candid, actionable guidance throughout development. Provide direct developmental or line-editing support when a project requires senior intervention.
  • Determine the appropriate editorial and verification process for each book, including when to commission technical, legal, or other specialist review.
  • Build, commission, and supervise a trusted network of developmental editors, line editors, copyeditors, fact-checkers, proofreaders, indexers, typesetters, and specialist reviewers.
  • Give final editorial approval before manuscripts enter production, and remain responsible for editorial decisions and author review through the proof stages.
  • Maintain the Stripe Press house style and create clear, repeatable workflows and handoffs across editorial and production.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • You have significant experience managing complex nonfiction books at a trade, academic, journalistic, or ideas-focused publishing organization.
  • You demonstrate exceptional editorial judgment across structure, argument, prose, evidence, and authorial voice.
  • You are comfortable working with technical, scientific, economic, historical, or otherwise research-intensive nonfiction.
  • You have deep knowledge of developmental editing, line editing, copyediting, fact-checking, permissions, proofreading, and editorial-production workflows.
  • You are an exceptional project manager, capable of coordinating multiple complex projects and timelines with a high degree of precision.
  • You enjoy operating in a small, ambitious organization where systems are still being built, and you share Stripe Press’s appetite for ideas that can improve how people understand and shape the world.

Preferred qualifications

  • You have helped launch or materially scale a publishing program, list, or imprint.
  • You have developed editorial standards, tools, or workflows that improved quality and execution in a growing organization.

About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

Polymarket ships fast. New products, new market types, new payment rails, new geographies: the pace is real and it does not slow down for anyone. The Customer Experience team's job is to make sure that speed does not come at the cost of the people using the platform. Right now, CX readiness for new launches is a gap we need to close, and this role closes it.

You will own launch readiness for CX end to end. That means getting into product planning early, building the readiness plan, standing up a small pilot support pod, and running it until the launch is stable enough to hand off to our scaled operation or external partners. You will write the playbook as you go, because in many cases nobody has supported this type of product before. The team you will work with spans support operations, enablement, and external partners, and you will be the connective tissue between all of them and the Product teams shipping new things.

This is a builder role. If you need a defined process to work within, this is not the right fit. If you are energized by figuring out how to support something that has never been supported before, and then making sure the next person does not have to figure it out from scratch, this is exactly the right fit.

What You'll Do

  • Build and own the CX readiness plan for every new product, market type, and geography launch, from kickoff through stable handoff.
  • Embed with Product teams at the planning stage to surface support needs, flag risks, and make sure CX requirements are scoped in before engineering is done.
  • Stand up and directly manage pilot support pods for new launches, including staffing, tooling, and day-to-day operations during the incubation period.
  • Work with the Enablement team to produce training materials, SOPs, and QA criteria before each launch goes live.
  • Track contact rates, issue trends, and customer satisfaction data for newly launched products and report findings back to Product with clear recommendations.
  • Define the criteria for what "stable" looks like for each launch, and execute the handoff to scaled operations or external partners once those criteria are met.
  • Build the readiness framework for international expansion, accounting for language, regulatory context, and partner capability as Polymarket enters new markets.

  • Organized and reliable follow-through: teams and partners depend on you to track details and close loops without being chased.
  • (Plus) Experience at a startup or high-growth company where the roadmap changed fast and you had to adapt your plans to match.

Benefits

Pay Transparency

OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Hong Kong, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
 
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 
 
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
 

About The Opportunity

OKX is building out its equities and tokenized securities business. This is a post-trade and brokerage systems product role — you will own the layer that sits between our users and the securities markets: order management, execution, settlement, asset servicing and reconciliation.
We have strong crypto product and engineering talent. What this role brings is depth in brokerage architecture and securities market structure: how these systems are built, why they are built that way, and what breaks at scale. You will be the internal authority on that, and your judgment will shape decisions that are expensive to reverse.

What You’ll Be Doing 

  • Own the brokerage core — order management, execution and routing, instrument lifecycle and trading status, settlement and reconciliation.
  • Shape account, custody and clearing architecture, along with the operating model required to run it.
  • Own corporate actions and asset servicing end to end, in both conventional and on-chain form.
  • Define how securities risk and margin frameworks coexist with those of a 24/7 digital asset market.
  • Bring market structure, execution quality and regulatory requirements into product decisions early, before they become blockers.
  • Set the standard for rigour — write PRDs precise enough to build from, and lead alignment across engineering, risk, legal, compliance and treasury.

What We Look For In You 

Domain Depth
  • 5+ years in post-trade or brokerage systems product management. We strongly prefer candidates from internet and licensed brokerages — Futu, Tiger, Interactive Brokers, Robinhood, Webull, Longbridge — as well as clearing firms and brokerage infrastructure providers.
  • Architectural perspective. You have a clear view of where responsibility belongs across the order, execution, clearing, settlement, asset servicing and ledger layers, and of what goes wrong downstream when a boundary is drawn in the wrong place.
  • Depth across the order and execution path. Order types and parameters, state machine design, idempotency across an external execution boundary, cancel/replace and partial-fill semantics, timeout and exception recovery. This is the core craft of the role.
  • End-to-end ownership of at least one area beyond the order path — clearing and settlement, corporate actions and asset servicing, margin and risk, securities lending, or position and cash reconciliation.
  • Commercial and historical perspective. You understand how a brokerage actually earns, how each revenue line constrains the systems beneath it, and why the industry made the structural choices it did.
Ways of Working
  • Strong technical intuition. You are comfortable discussing system architecture and data flows with engineers. You do not need to be a developer, but you think with the rigour of one.
  • You design for the exceptions — the halted symbol, the timed-out counterparty, the partial fill, the corporate action mid-flight — not just the order that goes through.
  • You run programs, not just write specs. You produce rigorous PRDs independently, drive alignment across engineering, risk, legal, compliance and treasury, and own the full lifecycle from requirements through post-launch review.
  • You write precisely, and can make complex mechanics legible to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • High agency. You are comfortable taking an open question all the way to a shipped, reconciled system, and making calls with incomplete information.
  • Proficiency in Mandarin is required to communicate effectively with internal engineering and product stakeholders in the China-based R&D center.

Nice-To-Haves 

  • Product experience with margin financing or securities lending.
  • Exposure to tokenized securities, digital asset custody, or on-chain settlement.
  • Experience integrating with broker-dealer or clearing APIs, as either the integrator or the provider.
  • Hands-on experience with multi-jurisdiction regulatory frameworks — SEC/FINRA, MiFID II, or equivalent.
  • A track record of launching a brokerage product in a new market from zero.
  • Fluency in English to support communication with global product and business stakeholders.
  • Genuine curiosity about what happens when securities markets meet 24/7 markets.

Perks & Benefits 

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
